question: Can external OS native instruction-pointer samples identify source-relevant native CPU functions in the existing focal RPC family, while keeping all original WAMP work and runtime policies unchanged? This does not answer Dart allocation class/stack or physical RAM cause.
selection_basis: All six source-defined construction/implementation variants of the previously inspected cleartext RawSocket RPC family plus ALL five retained original primary RSS passing controls. Scope selected from ALREADY EXISTING original results; any later declaration predates only NEW diagnostic data, not original data.
work_policy: Original full fresh application bodies/patterns/byte verification, minimum1000samples/10s, concurrency1/inflight1/routerworker1/nativethread1 and original JIT SDK/GC/allocator/worker policies. Exact frozen inventory/order/scenarios/config/argv/env must be bound and source-checked before readiness. No native/client/broker substitute.
observer_design: External Linux perf CPU-clock frequency999 flat instruction-pointer sampling over an owned blocked launcher/driver and its descendants. Do not ask VM service for CPU/allocation/heap profiles, clear samples, set flags, add JIT-symbol flags, force/reset GC, alter frame-pointer/unwinder build policy, or change benchmark driver/runtime code.
arming_design: A NEW declared minimal owned wrapper waits before exec of exact frozen driver argv. Perf control enable acknowledgement and controller identity check must precede releasing its one-shot exec barrier. Same PID across exec; trace all descendants. Pending proof: kernel perf inheritance/readiness, immutable launcher/wrapper/driver/native/flags/locks/source/body policies and fresh source/data identity. No real launch yet.
scope_and_retention: Whole owned execution lifetime, all warmups/repetitions/codecs/cases, all sampled records and unresolved/unclassified/lost samples retained. Role reports classify actual process instances via PID+starttime/lineage+exec+loaded-image identity. No trimming to favorable windows/results. Whole-life native sample counts are not gate-interior CPU ratios, allocation volume, RSS, managed stacks, causal repair or acceptance.
source_capability_lead: Own retained original production0B23 ELF has symtab/dynsym/text and native FlatBuffers/FFI symbol names. Static tables only; no measured hotspot or future loaded-image identity established. JIT addresses may remain unresolved.
required_before_data: Separate helper/controller source in owned isolated preparation with existing exact601 bootstrap/fast/full baseline; no production runtime edit.
Meaningful synthetic/adversarial ordering/identity/policy/retention/output/refusal tests under official exclusive lease, with no benchmark workload.
Qualified local test/review advice and root source review; no model approval inference.
Source/native/driver/archive/config/actual lock/generated package-config/static RLIB/tool/kernel/SDK/permissions manifests and own appropriate verification; local/hosted cohorts distinct.
Exact scenario inventory/order/flags/env/window/fresh-body guards and both-role process/image identity plan; all declarations complete before NEW data.
Bounded resource/disk plan and official local leases/hosted concurrency; no reservation bypass or data/evidence cleanup.
One-shot consumed marker and exclusive outputs/partials preserved. No retry, cancellation, favorable host/subset/result selection or fallback observer/flags after any data.
Capability/setup refusal retained before any workload. No readiness on incomplete/truncated identity or unsupported perf. No target API/capture currently authorized by this draft.
